myojo-sama, nice to meet you! I'm Nekotanuki, a VTuber working independently. Your work here was absolutely amazing!!!! ✨️✨️ https://skeb.jp/@hachibun/works/8

■ Request Details Please create an illustration of Nekotanuki performing the so-called "superhero landing" pose (one knee and one hand on the ground) right after landing from a high place. ※ Attached pose reference image in the URL. Size should be landscape 16:9, and please make the gaze meet the viewer's eyes.

【Nekotanuki Appearance & Costume】 https://x.com/nekotanuki6/status/1984115141538197840
Hairstyle: Wolf Cut Outfit: Cyber Outfit ＜Points to Include＞ ・Must include the trademark "fried egg" accessory. ・The pupils contain highlights matching the hair's highlight color. 【About the Mascot】 ・The creature on the shoulder is called "Tanuki Pants." Its depiction is optional.

■ Nekotanuki's Personality (For reference) ・Full of energy ・Expressive ・Hates losing ・A glutton ■ Potential Uses ・Use on social media (X, YouTube, etc.) for VTuber activities ・Membership perks (distribution to fan site supporters, rewards, wallpapers, etc.) ・Net print (may overlay text/elements) ・Combining with text or free assets, minor editing that doesn't compromise the image (color correction, cropping, etc.) ・Merchandise sales ※If the above uses are difficult, we sincerely apologize but would appreciate it if you could cancel the order. ■ Desired Delivery Format Layered PSD data (or data containing transparent PNGs) with character, background, signature, etc.

Hello~! Your artwork is beautiful!

I was wondering if I would be able to request an illustration of my vtuber Aisling in 16:9 format, on the beach in a swimsuit that is modest but cute~! I really like the swimsuits here (https://uk.pinterest.com/aisliboo0999/1/), but please feel free to design something original that is similar to these if you are okay with that! I would like for the swimsuit to be purple.

My vtuber, AshiiiBoo or Aisling Boo, is a ghost who died in historical England~! The dark markings on her body are a sign of her cause of death, so please include them! I have included a sketch in my drive link with the location of the markings on her body!

I would love to use the artwork for sns such as twitter, twitch, youtube, etc as well as vtubing activities. I would like to use it for stickers or merch! If possible, please include a psd with the layers separated~!

Thank you~!
